en: The image features a black and white photograph of an ornate, castle-like building situated atop a steep, terraced hillside covered with vegetation and fenced pathways. The structure features Neo-Gothic architectural details such as battlements, pointed turrets, and arched windows. A stone stairway and a small stone hut or cellar with a wooden door can be seen in the foreground, leading up the hill toward the building.
